Do you remember the first time you reversed out of the driveway on your own? That feeling was pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment was probably one of the most heart-pounding of their lives. When you were a teenager, your parents had absolutely no way of knowing whether you were speeding, when you would arrive, or whether your driving behaviour was safe enough. All they could do was adopt a 'no news is good news' attitude, hoping was their only tool until you proactively checked in.

If you have a teen driver today, you should count yourself lucky, because the unknown fear your parents' generation endured is no longer the world you have to face. While 2026 technology brings plenty of downsides, HeyPolo is precisely a prime example of how technology is making teen driving better and safer.

HeyPolo is far more than just a paid version of Apple's 'Find My' service

HeyPolo is a family safety app that combines real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all in one package at one price. Its driving features are precisely what sets it apart from basic location-sharing apps like Apple's 'Find My'. Every trip your teen driver takes is tracked and scored, and you can clearly see the trip details: whether they were speeding, whether they used their smartphone while driving, whether there was any hard braking or sudden acceleration, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

The driving score assigns a rating to each trip based on your child's actual driving performance, so you no longer have to rely on guesswork to judge whether they are driving safely. You can see the actual data, and if the performance is not ideal, you can have a serious conversation with them and watch the score gradually improve as their driving habits get better. Compared with anything available to the previous generation, this is a far more effective way to help new-licence drivers keep improving.

Crash detection, arrival notifications, and plenty more practical features

HeyPolo can detect a crash and automatically notify you. Combined with the arrival notification feature — whether your child is going to school, to sports practice, to a friend's house, or back home, the system sends an alert immediately — you go from the old approach of just 'hoping no news is good news' to truly knowing their safety status. You no longer have to wait anxiously for them to send a message or call to check in; the moment they arrive, you will know straight away, and for parents, that peace of mind is truly priceless. HeyPolo updates the location every 5 seconds, ensuring you always have the most accurate whereabouts at your fingertips.

One price covers the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription account covers your entire family, with absolutely no per-person surcharges. The app works seamlessly between iPhone and Android, so it makes no difference if some family members use iPhone and others use Android. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, which means it has very robust privacy infrastructure. They will not sell your data, you have full control over who you share with and to what extent, you can stop sharing at any time, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is absolutely critical.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, so trying it out is completely risk-free. Even if you ultimately decide it's not for you and your family, there are no binding contracts, so there's no reason not to give it a go.
